direct_evidence.title: 2026-09-28-rcs-29145-resolucion-interna
direct_evidence.body:
Resolution summary, 9/28.

Issue: Joe Austin reported Smart Alerts stopped around 9/23 for Vitamin Shoppe, client 433. Grafana export of 9/25, 20:05 to 23:40 UTC, shows 68 "still on processing" exits for 433, same pattern as RCS-29123. Start date for 433 not confirmed in Grafana.

Cause, per Kiran Vadday on RCS-29123: deadlock in ProcessSmartAlert when runs process in parallel.

Fix: PR 58273, US prod 9/28.

Verification: Joe ran a test alert on 9/28 and confirmed delivery.

Open: the fix does not reprocess cases stuck with InProcess = 1. Alerts missed 9/23 to 9/28 not resent. Customer offered a resend by case number.

Related: RCS-29123, RCS-29026, RETAILIT-20901.

direct_evidence.title: 2026-09-28-rcs-29145-respuesta-joe
direct_evidence.body:
Hello Joe,

Thank you for testing it so quickly, and for confirming it came through.

Our engineering team found that Smart Alert runs were blocking each other when several cases processed at the same time, so some alerts stayed pending and never went out. A change released on 9/28 makes each run wait for the previous one, and alerts are processing normally again.

Alerts for cases saved between 9/23 and that change were not sent. If you would like any of them sent now, just reply with the case numbers.

I will go ahead and close this one out. If anything comes back, just reply here and it will reopen.

Juan

reference_evidence.title: 2026-09-30-smart-alerts-rca-teams-camila
reference_evidence.body:
Camila, Kiran confirmo la causa raiz de las Smart Alerts. El cambio a .NET Framework 4.8 (PR 57544) expuso un deadlock entre Await y GetAwaiter().GetResult() en el proceso de Smart Alerts. El proceso se quedaba bloqueado despues de enviar, no registraba en SmartAlertProcess y las alertas siguientes no salian. Lo corrigio agregando ConfigureAwait(False) en dos Await: https://dev.azure.com/apprissdevops/Sysrepublic%20Secure/_git/Secure/pullrequest/58274
Afecto a ADUSA desde el 9/24 7:06 AM ET hasta el fix del 9/28 (RCS-29123), y a Vitamin Shoppe (RCS-29145). La explicacion del 9/28 sobre el trafico en paralelo queda descartada. Por pedido de Jim, las alertas perdidas no se reenvian. Con esto ajusto el borrador del RCA.
